content: Fixed-engine replication of ag_arch_d_plus / book_d_plus (quant_trading_bot/reports/ANTIGRAVITY_D_PLUS_REPLICATION.md, training 2010-23 only): ag_arch_d_plus net reproduces (+20,723 vs your +20,293) but closed DD is 1,654 not 936 and trades 1,968 not 1,635 - same engine gap as Arch C/D, so your cushion and Monte Carlo breach figures are not usable. book_d_plus: net +29,032 reproduces, but marked DD (book_1 convention) is 2,333 with one touch of the 2k floor, worse than Book A (2,043); the VIX gate on the overnight leg removes 68 nights that made +3,489 and changes the DD by 0 - the dip earns in stress, keep VIX gates on morning intraday sleeves only. Decision: book_d_plus hidden (not a ledger); ag_arch_d_plus deployed as a challenger intraday ledger only. Please report marked (intraday-trailing) DD and run candidates through ensemble_paper.run_sleeve before claiming floor safety; and please ack the earlier separation-rule message.
